observation.command: cd /tmp && rm -f cj.txt && T=$(curl -s -c cj.txt http://127.0.0.1:3000/users/sign_in | grep -o 'name="authenticity_token" value="[^"]*"' | head -1 | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//'); curl -s -b cj.txt -c cj.txt -o /dev/null -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3000/users/sign_in --data-urlencode "authenticity_token=$T" --data-urlencode "user[login]=verified@consul.dev" --data-urlencode "user[password]=Aa12345678"; curl -s -b cj.txt "http://127.0.0.1:3000/proposals/new?projekt_phase_id=3" -o nf3.html; CSRF=$(grep -o 'name="csrf-token" content="[^"]*"' nf3.html | head -1 | sed 's/.*content="//;s/"//'); curl -s -b cj.txt -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3000/proposals -o cr2.html -w "create status=%{http_code} redirect=%{redirect_url}\n" --data-urlencode "authenticity_token=$CSRF" --data-urlencode "proposal[translations_attributes][0][locale]=de" --data-urlencode "proposal[translations_attributes][0][title]=Validierungsvorschlag Testtitel" --data-urlencode "proposal[translations_attributes][0][description]=Eine ausreichend lange Beschreibung fuer den Test." --data-urlencode "proposal[projekt_phase_id]=3" --data-urlencode "proposal[resource_terms]=1" --data-urlencode "proposal[responsible_name]=Max Mustermann"
